en: A black and white photograph of a street scene with a large hotel building labeled 'Hotell Central' and 'Kafé Central' at the front. Several cars and bicycles are visible, along with people cycling and walking. The architecture and vehicles suggest a mid-20th-century European setting. There is handwriting above the buildings identifying locations or people, and the bottom left corner has 'S.W.S. ELVERUM' printed, indicating a possible publisher or location.
